in_marathi.name: Karpagavalli
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess Karpagam's grace
in_marathi.long_meaning: Karpagavalli हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Karpagavalli is a name derived from the Sanskrit term 'Karpagam', which refers to a wish-fulfilling tree in Hindu mythology. The name is associated with the Goddess Karpagam, who is believed to grant boons to those who seek her blessings. Karpagavalli is often invoked during prayers for prosperity, fertility, and good fortune.

vedic_reference.note: Goddess Karpagam is a form of Goddess Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge and learning. She is also known as Vidyavalli (knowledge giver) and Vidya (knowledge). The name Karpagavalli signifies a wish-fulfilling tree of knowledge and learning.
